title: Vintage Le Creuset Paon Fondue Set – Made in France
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset “Paon” fondue set featuring the iconic 1970s orange and brown peacock-inspired pattern. A rare and highly collectible retro set, both decorative and functional.
Authentic Le Creuset pieces, all made in France. A hard-to-find complete set, perfect for collectors, vintage kitchen lovers, or cozy fondue dinners.
The fondue pot measures approximately 13 cm high and 14 cm in diameter. Overall in very good vintage condition with normal signs of age and use. Please see photos for details.
